reason: Three completed 2026-08-31 Research Objects were converted into complete bilingual Editorial Architecture 2.1 candidates with verified planning artifacts, evidence-bounded claims and deterministic baseline covers.
reason_zh: 三份已完成的 2026-08-31 Research Object 已转换为完整双语 Editorial Architecture 2.1 候选，具备已核验的规划工件、有边界的证据声明和确定性基础题图。

candidates.title: A Standing Rule Is Not This Action’s Authority
candidates.title_zh: 长期规则，不是这一次行动的授权
candidates.researchQuestion: 数字员工如何复用长期权限偏好，同时避免把偏好静默变成某次具体后果性行动的最终授权？
candidates.coreProposition: Standing permission policy and occurrence authority should be separate governance objects: a reusable policy may route a future action to Allow, Ask or Never, but whenever the decision remains open, final authority must bind the concrete occurrence and be independently auditable.

sections.heading: Fewer Prompts Do Not Establish Equivalent Protection
sections.heading_zh: 减少提示，不等于保持同等保护

sections.heading: The Most Common Authored Rule Was “Ask Me Then”
sections.heading_zh: 用户最常写下的规则，是“到时再问”

sections.heading: Two Objects Answer Two Different Questions
sections.heading_zh: 两个对象，回答两个不同问题

sections.heading: Standing Allow Needs Its Own Authority Basis
sections.heading_zh: 长期允许也需要自己的权威来源

sections.heading: Audit Must Reconstruct This Decision
sections.heading_zh: 审计应能重建这一次决定

evidenceClaims.claim: The primary study reports lower raw overreach blocking in the policy condition than in per-action HITL while required-action completion remains high.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 一手研究报告：策略条件的原始越权阻止率低于逐动作人在回路，而必要动作完成率仍保持较高。

evidenceClaims.claim: 114 of 140 authored consequence-category rules selected Ask.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 140 条用户自定义后果类别规则中有 114 条选择运行时询问。

evidenceClaims.claim: The main experiment used a fixed researcher-checked action-to-consequence mapping.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 主要实验使用研究者核验的固定动作到后果映射。

evidenceClaims.claim: Standing policy is a durable routing rule rather than automatic final authorization for every matching occurrence.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 长期策略是持久决策路由规则，而不是每次匹配发生的自动最终授权。

evidenceClaims.claim: Occurrence authority should bind policy version, consequence class, proposed effect, target and final commitment.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 具体发生的授权应绑定策略版本、后果类别、拟执行效果、目标与最终承诺。

projectRelevance.rationale: The argument remains complete without first-party project mapping.

communityEdition.rationale: The complete Research Center edition already carries the transferable argument; a separate edition would repeat the same evidence.

candidates.title: A Reconstructed Role Is Not Proof of Authority
candidates.title_zh: 重建出的角色，不是权威来源
candidates.researchQuestion: 上下文转换必须保留哪些权威事实，才能让下游智能体或权限审查器区分真实用户权威与被重建到高权限位置的低权限内容？
candidates.coreProposition: Reconstructed message role is not sufficient authority provenance: original principal, origin channel, privilege class and any trusted privilege transition must remain independently inspectable across persistence, summarization, handoff and context reconstruction.

sections.heading: The Attack Changes Effective Privilege, Not Just Text
sections.heading_zh: 攻击改变的不是文本，而是有效权限

sections.heading: Risk Review Cannot Repair a Corrupted Principal Premise
sections.heading_zh: 风险审查不能修复错误的主体前提

sections.heading: Provenance Must Be Independent of Message Role
sections.heading_zh: 权威来源必须独立于消息角色

sections.heading: Persistence and Handoff Are Privilege Boundaries
sections.heading_zh: 持久化与交接也是权限边界

sections.heading: Explicit Adoption Is Possible
sections.heading_zh: 显式采纳与永久污染都不是答案

evidenceClaims.claim: The study reports successful tool-to-user privilege escalation for all 13 tested objectives across six harnesses in the full-access setting.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 研究报告：完全访问设置中，六个运行框架的 13 个工具到用户权限提升目标全部成功。

evidenceClaims.claim: Under automatic permission review for three harnesses, context privilege transformation succeeds where the conventional comparison is 0/13.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 在三个自动权限审查运行框架中，上下文权限转换成功，而传统比较为 0/13。

evidenceClaims.claim: The study covers persistence through goals, scheduled tasks and skill-like mechanisms.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 研究覆盖通过目标、计划任务与技能式机制进行持久化的路径。

evidenceClaims.claim: Context reconstruction is authority-bearing when it changes effective instruction privilege.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 只要上下文重建改变指令的有效权限，它就携带权威含义。

evidenceClaims.claim: High-impact authorization should consume original-principal provenance and explicit privilege-transition evidence.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 高影响授权应消费原始主体来源与显式权限转换证据。

projectRelevance.rationale: The argument is a general agent-harness provenance problem.

communityEdition.rationale: A separate community edition would repeat the same evidence without a distinct professional discussion angle.

candidates.title: A Successful Rerun Does Not Prove the Repair
candidates.title_zh: 重跑成功，不等于修复成立
candidates.researchQuestion: 受治理智能体运行体在恢复实验中必须固定什么、允许改变什么，才能支持因果修复，而不只是一次幸运重跑？
candidates.coreProposition: A causal repair claim requires an authoritative failed logical prefix, fail-closed divergence detection, an explicit intervention anchor, and independent qualification of external state needed by the live suffix; rerun success alone is resampling evidence, not proof of repair.

sections.heading: Rerun Changes Too Many Variables at Once
sections.heading_zh: 重跑把太多变量一起换掉

sections.heading: Turn the Failed Prefix into a Versioned Test Fixture
sections.heading_zh: 把失败前缀变成版本化测试夹具

sections.heading: Targeted Intervention Produces More Informative Evidence
sections.heading_zh: 指向可疑节点，比盲目再试更有信息量

sections.heading: Logical Equality Does Not Recreate the External World
sections.heading_zh: 逻辑前缀一致，还不等于外部世界一致

sections.heading: Three Operations Need Three Receipts
sections.heading_zh: 三种操作，需要三类回执

evidenceClaims.claim: Controlled replay reproduces the same failure more often than unguided rerun under the tested protocols.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 在测试协议下，受控重放比完整重跑更常复现同一失败。

evidenceClaims.claim: The study reports 6.90% unguided-rerun pass@3 repair and 20.15% symptom-driven single-attempt repair.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 研究报告：完整重跑的第三次尝试内修复率为 6.90%，症状驱动单次干预修复率为 20.15%。

evidenceClaims.claim: Replay validates event position and request alignment and stops on divergence.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 重放核验事件位置与请求对齐，并在分歧时停止。

evidenceClaims.claim: Reported replay exactness is limited to represented state and does not recreate external side effects.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 报告的重放一致性只适用于已表示状态，不会重建外部副作用。

evidenceClaims.claim: Causal repair needs separate logical-prefix and external-state validity checks.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 因果修复需要分别检查逻辑前缀与外部状态有效性。

evidenceClaims.claim: Rerun, replay and repair should be distinct Runtime operations with distinct evidence semantics.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 完整重跑、受控重放与修复应是证据语义不同的独立运行操作。

projectRelevance.rationale: The argument is a general recovery-verification pattern.

communityEdition.rationale: The Research Center edition already provides the complete engineering argument; a second edition would add no distinct angle.
